object.description: The vendor-specific device information, which is included in the value of the ''LLDPDU's'' Organizationally Specific TLV (TLV Type = 127). {{keys}} Note: It is assumed that this object might be used for HTIP (Home-network Topology Identifying Protocol) {{bibref|JJ-300.00}} and {{bibref|G.9973}}. In this case, this table contains the Organizationally Specific TLV (TLV Type = 127) of ''LLDPDU'', in which the {{bibref|OUI}} in the third octet is E0271A (''TTC-OUI''), the organizationally defined subtype in the sixth octet is 1 (''Device Information''), and the device information ID in the seventh octet is 255 (''Vendor-specific extension field'').
